title: Towards a furniture passport
subtitle: What Regen Studio did with Meubelmakerij Houtgoed to give one chair a digital product passport: 218 data points explored, a system built that follows the working day, and the passport placed on the maker's own website.
featuredImageAlt: The Stadstoel drawn in facets: a wooden rocking chair with a red strip of teak, side boards that run on as rockers and the Regen Studio logo, while coloured triangles drift off the backrest
excerpt: Regen Studio and Meubelmakerij Houtgoed explored which information a small furniture maker needs for a digital product passport: 218 data points, 129 in the passport and 89 in the maker's own records. We built a system that follows the working day, let the 3D model help fill it in, and put the passport of the Stadstoel, with versioning, on the maker's website.
